dogecoin.text:
$TRUMP is about to onboard the new dogecoiners of 2025. 

That is the same type of people that pumped dogecoin, shiba inu, baby shiba, shiba dad, etc.

They're going to be our little brothers. Degenerate little brothers.

You should be happy of $TRUMP success even if you missed it.

Remember that in the last cycle one of the main reasons for people to start their journey in crypto was to buy $DOGE. 

Dogecoin onboarded a lot of people who then joined $SHIBA who then learned about DEFI, NFTs, ICOs.
